metadata.title: Massive perturber-driven interactions of stars with a massive black hole

notes: No eligible stars identified. The paper discusses hypervelocity stars only as a population or refers to “two of the recently observed HVSs” without giving individual names or catalog identifiers (T:p9-b8; T:p10-b2; T:p10-b4; T:p10-b11), so no individually identifiable star can be listed with an explicit Galactic-unbound candidacy. The S-stars/B-stars near the Galactic MBH are also discussed collectively and as bound/captured stars, not as Galactic unbound candidates (T:p8-b12; T:p9-b4).
